items.prompt: If she ___ her knee last year, she would be competing in the final next week.

explanation.en: A past condition (last year) with a present or future result: past perfect in the if clause.

optionNotes.en: The past simple does not mark an unreal past in the if clause.
Would never goes in the if clause.

items.prompt: If he weren't so careless with details, the report ___ so many errors last month.

explanation.en: A general trait (weren't) with a past result (last month): would have + past participle.

optionNotes.en: Wouldn't contain refers to the present, but last month is past.
Hadn't contained cannot be a result clause.

items.prompt: If I'd listened to my dad, I ___ in debt now.

explanation.en: A past condition with a present result (now): would + infinitive.
explanation.es: «Si le hubiera hecho caso, ahora no estaría»: wouldn't be.

optionNotes.en: Would have been refers to the past, but now is present.
Hadn't been cannot be the result clause.

items.prompt: If universities ___ more funding in the 1990s, they would be better equipped today.

explanation.en: In the 1990s is past, so the if clause uses the past perfect.

optionNotes.en: The past simple does not make an unreal past condition.
Would never goes in the if clause.

items.prompt: If the mayor weren't so cautious, the new park ___ years ago.

explanation.en: A general trait with a past result (years ago): would have been + past participle.

optionNotes.en: Would be built looks to the present or future, but years ago is past.
Had been built cannot be a result clause.
